## Agent Name

Proposed name for the agent.

## Agent Responsibility

What is the single responsibility of this agent?
(Each agent should have one clearly defined job.)

## Which Tier Does This Agent Belong To?

- [ ] Tier 1 — Core (Orchestrator, Analysis, Strategy, Generation)
- [ ] Tier 2 — Execution (Browser, API, Automation)
- [ ] Tier 3 — Quality (Security, Performance, Database)
- [ ] Tier 4 — Intelligence (Analysis, Learning, Reporting)

## Inputs

What information does this agent receive?

## Outputs

What does this agent produce?

## AI or Deterministic?

Does this agent require AI, or can it be solved deterministically?
(See ADR-001: Deterministic before AI principle.)

## Dependencies

Which other agents or components does this agent depend on?

## Justification

Why is this agent needed?
Could its responsibility be handled by an existing agent?
